endpoint.source: exact project-scoped IAM compute catalog public endpoint for region/pool
endpoint.microversion: explicit CreateRequest.Microversion2.1..2.93, default2.1; dual headers, no implicit upgrade

request.schema: Gophercloud v2.13.0 servers.CreateOpts plus source-bound protected/extension DTOs generated from pinned Nova Zed3d1a705 schema
request.scope: immutable explicit project and location, exact IAM compute catalog endpoint
request.covered_fields: every confirmed Zed server create field through2.93; protected AdminPassword/UserData/Personality.Contents/BDM.ConnectionInfo/BDM.NoDevice revealed only to source-bound request fields
typed_extensions: SchedulerHints (native typed hints plus source-defined wildcard extension properties)
NetworkAttachments (explicit replacement of native networks; nullable port)
request.validation: field minimum versions, tag gaps2.33..2.41 for BDM and2.37..2.41 for networks, personality removed2.57, required networks and UUID format from2.37, hostname2.90 length2..63 label not FQDN, min/max positive ordered counts, source cert constraints; provider validates deployment permissions/quotas/extensions and remaining source constraints
request.sensitive_inputs: native plaintext AdminPass/nonempty UserData/Personality rejected; protected replacements preserve bytes and encode base64 exactly once
request.counts: multi-create supported; false return_reservation_id returns first VM only; no inferred refs for other VMs

response.mapping: CreateWithResult typed server-or-reservation union; compatibility Create returns first Server when reservation not requested; response follows the explicit request variant
response.server_mapping: all documented create response fields via servers.Server; adminPass/user_data removed from native plaintext fields and exposed protected; source ID/project checked
response.reservation_mapping: nonempty reservation_id retained as scoped server_reservation ref; no operation polling endpoint or resource adoption inferred
response.malformed: accepted receipt and trustworthy returned ID retained before unrelated decode failure

errors.malformed_success: accepted receipt plus protocol_error for mutation

server.deleted.pending: all documented existing states except ERROR

wait.availability: single-server refs only; CreateAndWait rejects multi-create/reservation before HTTP. No batch/reservation wait contract.

recovery.unknown_with_exact_resource: indeterminate observation; outcome remains unknown, no replay
recovery.reservation: unavailable: exact reservation ref is acknowledgement metadata, not a proof or a remotely readable reservation resource; receipt.Recovery unavailable; no scanning/adoption/replay
